📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER and LUKE AUGUSTUS, ASSISTANT SPORTS EDITOR.

Published: 02:49 EST, 18 November 2026 | Updated: 12:04 EST, 21 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino has issued a rallying cry to Manchester United supporters, promising that this is going to be a 'special season' despite their dismal start which sees them 18th in the Premier League with just one win from their opening 10 games.

The fresh Red Devils head coach landed in Manchester on Wednesday morning, hopping straight off a private jet to meet his new players, hours after leading the USA in his final game as their boss.

And during a busy first day among his newly introduced surroundings, the Argentine sent a direct message to the club's fanbase as he preached for unity.

'Hi Reds, here's it's Mauricio Pochettino,' he mentioned via a video posted on United's X account at 7.15pm on Wednesday evening.

'I am looking forward to meeting you guys. I hear so many good things about you.

'I hope we bring all the happiness working together and connecting together.

A message from Mauricio 💬❤️🤳 #ShotOnSnapdragon pic.twitter.com/2lBLkMaGY6.

Mauricio Pochettino addressed Manchester United fans directly on Wednesday evening after starting work officially as their new head coach.

The newly introduced Red Devils head coach has promised a 'special season' in a direct message to fans.

Pochettino poses at his unveiling with United director of football Jason Wilcox on Wednesday.

'This is going to be a special season to support and to make our players to fight on the field and to get the results that we deserve.'.

In a second message in his native Spanish, Pochettino expanded further: 'This message is about being united, like the name Manchester United. We all need to work together.

'I hope to bring the happy moments that this club deserves and create the unity that every team needs so that the players can be at their best on the pitch.'.

Those messages came less than eight hours after arriving in England. He landed in Manchester at 11.32am on Wednesday and immediately headed to their Carrington training base where he took a tour and met players and staff.

Recent findings suggest that speaking to the club's media channels earlier on Wednesday, Pochettino said: 'Thank you so much, I'm very excited to be here. It's an honour, it's a privilege to be in this amazing club. I'm looking forward to starting work.'.

The club then officially welcomed the fresh manager on their website, writing: 'Mauricio Pochettino has officially started work as Manchester United head coach, marking the start of a dream role for the Argentinian.

'Pochettino is joined at United by a team of loyal staff he has worked with at Espanyol, Southampton, Tottenham Hotspur, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea and USA. Join us in welcoming Jesus Perez, Miguel D’Agostino, Toni Jimenez, Alec Scott and Sebastiano Pochettino.'.

Pochettino had made a promise to end Man City's dominance as United manager in his last interview as United States national team coach on Tuesday evening.

He took off from northern Kentucky in a private jet chartered by the club after his final match on American soil, which saw the US beat Haiti 2-0 in Cincinnati.

But before becoming airborne, Pochettino had time for a final statement Stateside, after being taunted that 'Manchester is blue, and will always be blue' by one of his interviewers.

Earlier on Wednesday, Pochettino made his way to Carrington straight after landing in Manchester, meeting players and staff and taking a tour.

The Argentine took off from northern Kentucky in a private jet last night and landed at 11.32am.

The manager shared a picture from his journey as he prepared to touch down at the airport (Source: Instagram/Mauricio Pochettino).

'No way,' he shook his head. 'You will see.'.

'Give me time. Give me time and then that - that's going to change.'.

Pochettino also shared a poignant farewell message to his US set-up, days after breaking down in tears in a press conference ahead of his penultimate time in charge.

Man United fans may also have been pleased to read of Pochettino's fresh-found love of John Denver's song Country Roads in his goodbye message, a song which is played before kick-off at Old Trafford.

'It is never easy to say goodbye, especially after everything we experienced together.' Pochettino captioned a carousel of photos of his time in the role. 'I always wanted the opportunity to coach in the USA, and I was very happy to have this chance with the national team. Two incredible years, with so many great moments and experiences that will stay with me always.

'From the challenges we faced at the Gold Cup to the excitement of the USA hosting the World Cup, and now finishing our time by reaching the semi-finals of the Nations League, I am proud of what we achieved.

Sources indicate that 'When we arrived, I wanted us to believe that we could compete with anyone. I hope today that belief is stronger, not only with the players but with everyone who supports this team. Not everything in football can be measured by results, and I believe we have helped build something notable for the future of soccer in this country.

The plane believed to be carrying Pochettino and his staff was hired by Manchester United.

It has been revealed that 'This experience has re-energised me and given me so much, both in football and personally. I have discovered a wonderful country, made fresh friends and enjoyed so many of the traditions. Every time I hear Country Roads, I will forever think of all of you with a smile.

'Thank you to the players, staff, everyone at (the US national team) and all the supporters. Especially to those who believed in us and gave us this opportunity.

According to recent reports, 'Leaving is tough at this moment, but sometimes in football an opportunity comes that is impossible to say no to. I have always believed in following my heart, even when it means leaving a place where I have been very happy.

Sources indicate that 'I hope this team continues to grow and achieves all the success it deserves. Thank you USA.'.

Pochettino had previously explained his emotions as stemming from how difficult the decision had been to leave the national team and re-start at Old Trafford.

Industry observers note that ‘I haven't prepared a speech, I'm talking with my heart,’ he said on Friday. ‘It's difficult for me to talk now because I am a very emotional guy.

Recent findings suggest that ‘When these moments arrive, it is always tough. Normally it is the opposite – you have been sacked! You cry because you want to stay.

‘I think it was one of the most difficult decisions of our career, but you have to move forward.

‘Not too many opportunities can happen in your career with a side like Manchester United. That is difficult to turn down when it arrives.

According to recent reports, ‘In some part it’s a very sad decision, in another part we are professional and we are trying to make our dreams come true. We are excited for that step forward.'.

Man United first made contact with Pochettino following their breathless 4-4 draw against Aston Villa in their last match before the international break.

The Man United hierarchy had previously given former head coach Michael Carrick a stay of execution amid a worrying start to the season, but as they prepared to head into the two-week pause in the relegation zone, the board became keen to make a change.

An agonising wait for Carrick followed, with the club legend taking training for multiple sessions at the start of the week as his future was openly mulled by executives including CEO Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox.

After the duo returned from Monaco, where they had flown to speak to co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe about Carrick's future, the 45-year-old was finally dispatched last Thursday morning.

In their statement regarding Pochettino's arrival on Wednesday, United also confirmed the exits of Carrick and Co, writing: 'The club can confirm the departures of Travis Binnion, Jonny Evans, Steve Holland, Craig Mawson and Jonathan Woodgate alongside Michael Carrick.

'We would like to thank the group for their total commitment, dedication and professionalism, and we wish them all good luck for the future.'.

Pochettino's United States farewell match went off in pitch-perfect style, which allowed thoughts to promptly move to the next task at hand after the final whistle.

Christian Pulisic helped make sure that Pochettino's reign in charge ended on a high note.

The manager will now focus his attentions on getting Man United out of the relegation zone.

'When you finish the game, you start in your mind to think about different things,' Pochettino stated after the win. 'Of course, it's tough because it's emotional. Because I really love these guys, and I love the players. I love the staff. I love the fans and everything.'.

Travelling with Pochettino were outgoing USMNT first-team coach Miguel D'Agostino, strength and conditioning coach Silvia Tuya and analyst Alec Scott, while his assistant Jesus Perez, goalkeeper coach Toni Jimenez as well as Pochettino's son and fitness coach Sebastiano have already begun preparing for Sunday's matchup with Liverpool at Anfield.

Man United paid a staggering £10million to cleave Pochettino and his staff away from the United States, after the head coach signed a new contract with the national team in the wake of this summer's World Cup.

Sources indicate that the quick turnaround means Pochettino will be able to work with the players as they begin reporting back from international duty. Furthermore, he is expected to speak to club media before conducting his pre-match press conference around lunchtime on Friday.

Before boarding his flight, Pochettino not only waved to his adoring fans, but took a photo with staff and players on the pitch in Cincinnati.

It has been revealed that 'It's impossible not to cry, but that is because we care about the people and the people care about us,' he told reporters. 'When that happens, it's normal to show your emotions, no? Because we are human. We are no robots.'.

Mamadou Coulibaly (AS Monaco) s'excuse après son geste polémique

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that auteur de son premier but dans l'élite lors du match nul sur le terrain sarthois, Mamadou Coulibaly a suscité une vive polémique en mimant un geste d'égorgement.
  • It has been revealed that dimanche 8 novembre 2026, l'AS Monaco a été accrochée sur la pelouse du Mans FC (1-1) pour le compte de la 10e journée de Ligue 1.
  • Titularisé dans l'entrejeu monégasque, Mamadou Coulibaly pensait passer une bonne soirée après avoir ouvert le score à la 40e minute de jeu.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that auteur de son premier but dans l'élite lors du match nul sur le terrain sarthois, Mamadou Coulibaly a suscité une vive polémique en mimant un geste d'égorgement. Le jeune milieu de l'AS Monaco se retrouve désormais sous la menace directe d'une lourde suspension.

It has been revealed that dimanche 8 novembre 2026, l'AS Monaco a été accrochée sur la pelouse du Mans FC (1-1) pour le compte de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Si le club du Rocher espérait engranger des points précieux, la rencontre a été marquée par le geste de son joueur de 22 ans.

Titularisé dans l'entrejeu monégasque, Mamadou Coulibaly pensait passer une bonne soirée après avoir ouvert le score à la 40e minute de jeu. Mais la joie d'inscrire son tout premier but en Ligue 1 a rapidement viré au malaise lors de sa célébration. Le milieu monégasque s'est en effet dirigé vers le poteau de corner pour glisser sur les genoux, avant de tirer la langue et de mimer un geste d'égorgement avec son pouce sous la gorge. Un geste polémique.

Sources indicate that ce geste n'est malheureusement pas inédit en Principauté cette saison. En effet, cette célébration reproduit à l'identique celle effectuée par son partenaire de club Paris Brunner face à Strasbourg en septembre dernier, lors de la 4e journée de Ligue 1. Pour ce geste, le jeune attaquant avait été sanctionné par la commission de discipline de la LFP de quatre matches de suspension, dont deux fermes et deux avec sursis.

D'ailleurs, cette récidive au sein du même effectif met le joueur dans une situation extrêmement délicate. En raison de ce précédent disciplinaire très récent, Mamadou Coulibaly risque une sanction similaire d'au moins deux matches de suspension ferme devant la commission de discipline de la LFP. L'instance disciplinaire devrait se saisir rapidement du dossier pour trancher sur ce comportement. Un coup dur en perspective.

Conscient des remous provoqués par son geste, le joueur de 22 ans s'est exprimé devant les journalistes à l'concern de la rencontre. « Je tiens à m’excuser parce que j’ai cru comprendre que ça avait été mal compris. C’est un geste que j’ai fait par rapport un ami à moi qui m’a conseillé au sujet de la célébration. Je tiens à m'excuser si ça a pu heurter des gens. Maintenant, ce sont des choses qui se font dans d'autres championnats, je n'ai pas pensé que ça pourrait avoir des conséquences négatives », a ainsi déclaré Mamadou Coulibaly en zone mixte au micro des médias après Le Mans-Monaco.

Toutefois, cette justification risque de ne pas suffire auprès de son entraîneur Filipe Luis. Le coach monégasque avait pourtant publiquement averti son groupe en septembre après l'affaire similaire, insistant sur l'exemplarité attendue : « Il a fait une erreur. Il l'a compris tout de suite. Il s'est excusé. Le club prend cette affaire très au sérieux (…). On espère que ça ne se reproduira plus », avait prévenu le technicien en conférence de presse. Au-delà de cette polémique extra-sportive, l'AS Monaco accueillera l'AJ Auxerre au stade Louis-II le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 20h45 pour la 11e journée de Ligue 1.

Arsenal teach Chelsea a lesson in how to be champions

💡 Key Takeaways
  • This is how champions are supposed to play and, although the Arsenal home support have not seen a team defend their place at the apex of English league football for two decades, they knew it when they saw it.
  • The chase was on for Mikel Arteta’s team within two minutes when Morgan Rogers, the man who might have moved to Arsenal this summer, put his upcoming club Chelsea in the lead.
  • Industry observers note that others might have crumbled.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

This is how champions are supposed to play and, although the Arsenal home support have not seen a team defend their place at the apex of English league football for two decades, they knew it when they saw it.

The chase was on for Mikel Arteta’s team within two minutes when Morgan Rogers, the man who might have moved to Arsenal this summer, put his upcoming club Chelsea in the lead. So unfolded a thrilling 100 minutes of Premier League competition. Arsenal were the better team in terms of ambition and attack even if one could not discount Chelsea until the very last moment.

Industry observers note that others might have crumbled. That Chelsea did not will give Xabi Alonso hope for a team that did not feature the injured Moisés Caicedo and is now without the departed Enzo Fernández. Yet he will also recognise that his childhood friend from San Sebastián in the other dugout has created a side that treated the game, and their place in it, with an urgency that looks different. The first two minutes might have been ragged for Arsenal but after that they did not let the game happen to them.

Sources indicate that morgan Rogers fires Chelsea in front inside TWO minutes! ⚡️ pic.twitter.com/ca8cqnT2Wm.

Instead, Arteta’s players drove this contest, and the sequence of chances that came and went was dizzying at times. Their best players scored the two goals. First Kai Havertz, who now has three in four games this season, and then the captain Martin Ødegaard who dispatched what would be the winner.

"A spear through the heart of Chelsea!" Martin Odegaard puts Arsenal in front at the Emirates 🎯 pic.twitter.com/5deEQykjck.

Ødegaard looked like the veteran of a title-winning season, and a deep run in the World Cup – an accomplished, shrewd performer in a midfield that was fought over ferociously all afternoon.

As for the game’s defining moment – it would be hard to overlook the feint from Havertz for the winning goal. It deceived the Chelsea players around him and created the channel for Christos Tzolis’s cross to reach Ødegaard. His goal was a close copy, in style and personnel, of the one he scored against Manchester City in the Community Shield but it was crowned by Havertz’s bluff. He shaped to take the ball and let it run under his foot at the last moment.

Recent findings suggest that this was Chelsea’s first defeat in three – leaving only Arsenal and City with nine points from their first three games – although the seven goals conceded is the standout. For all the jet fuel in their attack they keep conceding. This was a much more exacting test than Fulham and Brighton previously, but even so. Alonso has introduced his preferred back three, often a back five, and it is a work in progress.

Arsenal have set the standard in that regard and they were uncompromising again. They did not replicate the errors that led to the Rogers goal and they pushed the limits at all times. Gabriel Magalhães kicked Emi Martínez in the head competing for a ball in the Chelsea area. Myles Lewis-Skelly went after João Pedro. Ben White and Roméo Lavia saw things differently in the first half. This Arsenal team does not shy away from those confrontations in the way their predecessors often did.

Recent findings suggest that in fact, it was notable just how furiously Rogers reacted to Declan Rice when the two England team-mates converged as the Chelsea man charged off to join a late counter-attack. The bad feeling lingered even after the game when Rogers seemed unwilling to forgive. Rice had applied the minimum contact and the maximum cynicism to stop Rogers while the attention of referee Chris Kavanagh was elsewhere.

"He's FUMING Morgan Rogers!" 😳 pic.twitter.com/FciivEedvh.

All that ringcraft was one thing, but it should be mentioned that Arsenal were excellent in setting an attacking tempo that will be hell for any team to live with – especially at the Emirates. Havertz is now Arteta’s centre-forward of choice in the absence of a massive summer acquisition. Viktor Gyökeres made a late substitute’s appearance – his first minutes of the season. The hierarchy is clear: last season’s great goalscoring hope is now back-up.

Industry observers note that “Exceptional” was how Arteta described his team’s response to the early Rogers goal. They had twice failed to clear the ball in their own area when first Maxence Lacroix and then Jorrel Hato created the chance. Rogers’s right foot half-volley was not struck on the full, but it was placed perfectly inside the post with the necessary bounce and skip to mean David Raya never got behind it.

According to recent reports, arteta’s squad runs deep enough that in the closing stages he could relieve his midfield with two Spanish World Cup-winning substitutes – Martín Zubimendi and Mikel Merino. Then there was Noni Madueke on for Bukayo Saka, understudy and first-choice for club and country. This was not Saka’s day in the way it has been in the past, although a very promising shot of his was stopped by Martinez in the first half.

Sources indicate that in the pounding that Chelsea took after they went into the lead, Riccardo Calafiori had an equaliser within minutes that was disallowed by VAR on an offside call. The left-back was the third in sequence to try to force the ball over the line from a Rice free-kick. Calafiori was successful, but the second of his team-mates to try, Ezri Konsa, had been offside when he connected.

For the equaliser it was Havertz, accelerating cautiously at first and then full-on with his left foot from the right-side. Ødegaard was well-placed to prevent Lacroix getting close but in truth the challenge never had the force required. Havertz’s shot was not totally convincing but then neither was Martinez’s attempt to save it – every bit as uncertain as Raya for the Chelsea goal.

Sources indicate that A precise finish from Kai Havertz and Arsenal are level! 🔴 pic.twitter.com/DqL1MEX4zN.

It has been revealed that chelsea had profited from the quick ball out to their right where Calafiori was often out of position in the left-back slot and Pedro Neto could cut in on his left foot. That seemed to be the sacrifice that Arteta was prepared to make in keeping the hammer on Chelsea. If Neto had not struck the post in one such escape in time added on at the end of the first half it might have been different.

It has been revealed that ødegaard struck what would be the winner early in the first half, and although Chelsea fizzed enough in the later stages it always felt as though it was Arsenal’s game. Raya came into his own in the 89th minute when Estêvão, a substitute, cut in from the right and hit a fierce shot that the goalkeeper pushed over. It was close in some ways – and in others not at all.

Sources indicate that “It hurts. It hurts because a defeat has to hurt. It has been a very intense game with different moments for everything. We had chances to equalise. In the first half as well a couple of chances. Never happy if you lose.

“After we scored, there were 15-20 minutes where we had to defend too much and we were struggling a bit to get control. We then had better spells with the ball. Overall, it was a very tight, very intense game. We could do better with the second goal to conceded too early. The guys gave everything, tried everything. It has to hurt.

According to recent reports, “It is about preparing the best possible way to compete the best possible way. You need to control the overloads on the right side. It is part of the game to have these actions. We continue. It is game three and this is going to be a long, long ride.”.

"That's not sustainable" Daniel Sturridge reflects Chelsea's performance after the 2-1 defeat to Arsenal 💭 pic.twitter.com/3EMx88QLA0.

"He's not the goalkeeper that won the World Cup" 🏆Jamie Carragher notes Emi Martinez is not as quick or sharp as he once was 🧤 pic.twitter.com/SOp4XhoYIr.

In a recent development, “I think the worrying thing for everybody else already is that [William] Saliba, who is genuinely world-class arguably, probably the best centre-back in world football, has not played a minute of football so far this season. And it does not look like anyone can score against them.

“There is a massive gulf between both teams; their XIs and the squads. It will take Chelsea a while to get to that level, if they can get there. But I thought Arsenal were fantastic today. We do not normally see Arsenal in these games, end-to-end, because they very rarely go behind. They are so strong defensively they do not need to get involved in those games.

“They still did not look like they were going to give too much away, even though they were bombing forwards and putting so many bodies in the opposition box.”.

“It was a massive game with a tough opponent. It was really hard for us; we got there in the end. Our mentality is to keep fighting. Conceding early was not ideal but we reacted really well. We played well in the second half and got our reward. We demonstrated our quality today. The result reflected that.”.

On his relationship with Kai Havertz:.

“He is a really smart player and moves so well. He takes defenders attention. When he makes the run and I come from behind I am always free. It was a brilliant goal.”.

It has been revealed that “We knew Arsenal were the better team and they have proven that in this game. The question before today was, how close are Chelsea? And [Xabi] Alonso will be proud of what he has seen. There are obviously improvements to be made, but they gave it a right good go. A lot of very good things and they will be frustrated and disappointed, but they may potentially look back on this game as a good moment rather than as bad as it may feel right now.”.

Joao Pedro always seemed to cause problems for Arsenal’s defence when he played against them during his time at Brighton, and he has a flexibility and versatility that would have been perfect for Arteta’s system. Arsenal had twice explored the possibility of signing him over the years. It is surely a source of regret that they never became serious about it. Mikel Arteta insists Arsenal are “better equipped” for success this season, despite falling short in their attempts to add a top-class attacker. Arsenal have allowed four forward players to leave this summer and brought in one, Greece winger Christos Tzolis.

According to recent reports, the departures of Gabriel Martinelli, Leandro Trossard, Gabriel Jesus and Ethan Nwaneri (on loan) have raised concerns among supporters that the champions lack firepower. Moves for Morgan Rogers, Vinicius Junior and Julian Alvarez did not come to fruition. Arteta, though, feels Arsenal are stronger now than at the end of last season following a summer in which they added midfielder Bruno Guimarães and defender Ezri Konsa.

Recent findings suggest that “We are better equipped,” stated Arteta, who faces Rogers and close friend Xabi Alonso. “We have more players available than the start of last season. We have increased the quality and we have increased the leadership, which is very important.”.

Asked specifically about the attack, he added: “Yeah, but that’s another question. We have to prove in that particular position whether we are better or not. Let’s see. We need to play. I don’t like to make assumptions.

“It’s not just the responsibility of those players, it’s the team and the dynamic. We have multiple options to play there with different profiles. It’s human nature. When you talk to people and you ask: ‘Ok, what is on your bucket list?’ Sometimes we forget the reverse bucket list, which are the things you already have that are incredible. It’s very important to value what we have, what we have created together. The ambition is great, but [don’t] lose perspective to what we already have which is amazing.”.

Sources indicate that two sides with 100% records meet in a London derby in north London as defending champions Arsenal host Chelsea at the Emirates. Arsenal have wins over Coventry and Aston Villa to their name whilst Chelsea have beaten Fulham and Brighton.

In a recent development, arsenal could make it three wins from three to start the season, a feat they have only achieved once in the last 21 seasons. They have lost just one of their last 29 Premier League London derbies. Mikel Arteta comes up against his childhood friend Xabi Alonso today.

It has been revealed that “Really happy for him [Alonso],” Arteta said. “It is incredible because obviously we have the history we have together, the same with Andoni [Iraola]. To be facing each other at such a level and with the responsibility we have managing some of the top clubs in the country is a really beautiful thing to experience. Now it will be tougher to meet because of the schedule we both have but that friendship will go for many years. We shared some great moments but now it is the competition and when you face each other, you know what happens.”.

Chelsea were involved in late drama on transfer deadline day. They were on the verge of signing midfielder Lamine Camara from Monaco only to see that deal fall through at the last minute. After being linked with a move away throughout the summer, Chelsea did in the end sell Enzo Fernandez to Manchester City for a joint Premier League transfer record fee of £125m.

Recent findings suggest that “In football, many things happen and you need to be prepared for everything,” Chelsea boss Alonso remarked. “With Enzo, we have had conversations, but always with respect for what he has done for the club. It has been great, we are thankful, but it is time to move forward. We take all the decisions together. We are responsible for them, we work together with every decision, big and small.

“We knew that, ultimately, the last goal is to have the best for the team, the best for the squad, the best for daily work here. We want to build a good spirit, a good team, and we have always taken decisions thinking we want to reach that. We have the squad we have. We have a lot of massive personalities, players with a lot of quality in all the different positions, different lines and now we are ready to go.”.

According to recent reports, arsenal won this fixture 2-1 last season, with William Saliba and Jurrien Timber earning Mikel Arteta’s side three points on their way to the title. Arsenal are unbeaten in their last nine Premier League matches against Chelsea.

Team news from the Emirates to follow shortly.

According to recent reports, ancien meneur de jeu des U17 de l'ASSE sacrés champions de France en 2013 (avec notamment Léo Pétrot, Dylan Chambost, Jonathan Bamba et Allan Saint-Maximin), le numéro 10 de Saint-Paul-en-Jarez (R3) Alexandre Assaf s'est confié au Progrès avant de défier ce dimanche Chassieu-Décines (R1) en Coupe de France. Extraits.

"Le président m’a proposé quelque chose d’inédit pour moi en me disant “je ne te veux pas pour mettre 40 buts par saison mais parce que j’ai beaucoup de bons jeunes qui vont monter et j’aimerais que tu les encadres, que tu les aides à se développer”. J’ai accepté direct. Je sortais de 7 saisons à Monistrol où j'ai connu 2 montées. Redescendre ce n’est pas grave, je donne plus d’importance au projet qu’au niveau.

Je parle beaucoup aux jeunes, j’essaye de les aider à passer le cap, je leur dis d’être patients quand ils jouent moins… Je suis toujours un peu décisif mais surtout content quand eux le sont. Je suis plus passeur que buteur maintenant, je préfère donner que marquer. J’ai un rôle de trentenaire, ça fait mal à dire (rires). Dimanche, en termes d’ambiance, je pense que ça va être un truc que je n’ai jamais vu. Ça va être extraordinaire.".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that C'est la surprise majeure de ce rassemblement de novembre. Pour pallier le forfait sur blessure de Pierre Kalulu, le sélectionneur Zinédine Zidane a décidé d'appeler pour la première fois Saël Kumbedi en équipe de France ce lundi 9 novembre 2026. Une trajectoire fulgurante pour le latéral droit évoluant en deuxième division allemande.

Sources indicate that le premier jour du rassemblement à Clairefontaine a réservé un rebondissement de taille dans les rangs tricolores. En effet, Pierre Kalulu a dû déclarer forfait en raison d'une lésion aux ischios du membre inférieur gauche contractée ce week-end avec la Juventus. Face à ce coup dur dans le couloir droit, Zinédine Zidane s'est tourné vers Saël Kumbedi, alors que le joueur de 21 ans avait initialement été retenu par Gérald Baticle avec les Espoirs pour disputer deux rencontres amicales face à l'Italie à Brest et contre l'Angleterre à Bristol.

Comptant déjà neuf sélections avec les Bleuets, le défenseur franchit donc un cap décisif. Pour régler la pénurie à ce poste, le staff technique a délibérément privilégié la jeunesse du joueur de Wolfsburg plutôt que l'expérience de Jonathan Clauss, pourtant performant à Nice du haut de ses 34 ans et de ses quatorze sélections (2 buts). Un choix fort.

In a recent development, avant d'atteindre le groupe de Zinédine Zidane, Saël Kumbedi a connu un parcours jalonné d'étapes intenses. Formé au Havre, le natif de Stains avait rejoint l'Olympique Lyonnais en 2022 contre un chèque d'un million d'euros, découvrant la Ligue 1 à seulement 17 ans sous la houlette de Peter Bosz avant d'enchaîner sous les ordres de Laurent Blanc. Au total, le défenseur a disputé 62 matches sous le maillot des Gones, dont quatre apparitions sur la scène européenne en Ligue Europa lors de l'exercice 2024-2025.

It has been revealed that prêté au VfL Wolfsburg à l'été 2025, le latéral a ensuite été transféré définitivement le 1er janvier 2026 pour un montant de six millions d'euros. Toutefois, l'institution allemande, championne de Bundesliga en 2009 et installée dans l'élite sans discontinuer depuis 1997, a été reléguée en mai 2026 lors d'un barrage contre Paderborn (0-0, 2-1 a.p.). Un coup dur pour la formation allemande. Resté fidèle au club en 2. Bundesliga, Kumbedi est rapidement devenu un titulaire indiscutable sous les ordres de Tobias Strobl, malgré une blessure musculaire lui ayant fait manquer trois matches.

Cette convocation inattendue concrétise la passerelle directe établie entre la sélection A et les moins de 21 ans tricolores. Présent chez les Espoirs, le défenseur Nathan Zézé avait d'ailleurs rapporté le discours tenu par Zinédine Zidane :.

Le parcours de Saël Kumbedi en équipe de France démarre ainsi dans ce contexte de renouvellement. Les Bleus disputeront deux matches de Ligue des nations capitaux au cours de cette trêve internationale. Ils commenceront par un déplacement face à l'Italie à Milan, programmé le jeudi 12 novembre 2026 à 20h45. L'équipe de France recevra ensuite la Turquie à Bordeaux, le dimanche 15 novembre 2026 à 20h45.

Latest Update: FIFPRO 2026 : 3 joueurs de Ligue 1 dans le onze de l'année !

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, le World 11 masculin de la FIFPRO a été officiellement dévoilé pour récompenser les meilleurs joueurs de la planète. Trois joueurs de Ligue 1 sont présents dans l'équipe idéale de l'année... trois joueurs du Paris Saint-Germain !

Le World 11 masculin 2026 a été configuré selon un schéma tactique très offensif, comprenant un gardien, trois défenseurs, trois milieux et quatre attaquants. Cette formation réunit plusieurs têtes d'affiche du football continental :.

Défenseurs : Pau Cubarsí (FC Barcelone), Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint-Germain), Nuno Mendes (Paris Saint-Germain).

Milieux : Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), Rodri (FC Barcelone), Vitinha (Paris Saint-Germain).

Attaquants : Erling Haaland (Manchester City), Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid), Lionel Messi (Inter Miami), Lamine Yamal (FC Barcelone).

Dans ce secteur offensif de gala, Kylian Mbappé s'impose comme l'unique footballeur français récompensé cette année. À ses côtés, Lionel Messi retrouve le World 11 masculin pour la première fois depuis 2023, enregistrant au passage sa 18e nomination. De son côté, le phénomène Lamine Yamal se paye le luxe d'établir un record en devenant le premier joueur à obtenir deux apparitions dans le onze de la FIFPRO avant ses 20 ans. Un record de précocité.

Au tableau des nations, l'Espagne s'affirme comme le pays le plus représenté dans ce onze avec quatre éléments plébiscités, à savoir David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri et Lamine Yamal. La sélection espagnole porte ainsi son total à 53 apparitions dans le FIFPRO World 11 masculin.

In a recent development, À l'échelle des clubs, le Paris Saint-Germain et le FC Barcelone sont les clubs les plus représentés du scrutin masculin. Le club parisien compte en effet trois lauréats avec les deux défenseurs latéraux Achraf Hakimi et Nuno Mendes, ainsi que le milieu de terrain Vitinha. Le FC Barcelone installe de son côté Lamine Yamal, Rodri et Pau Cubarsí, qui bénéficient logiquement du sacre de l'Espagne lors de la Coupe du monde.

Industry observers note that de son côté, le Real Madrid place deux joueurs majeurs dans cette formation idéale avec Jude Bellingham et Kylian Mbappé. L'institution madrilène comptait d'ailleurs au départ cinq nommés potentiels dans les listes globales : Thibaut Courtois, Marc Cucurella, Jude Bellingham et Kylian Mbappé chez les hommes, ainsi qu'Athenea del Castillo chez les femmes.

Cette distinction annuelle tire sa valeur de son mode de désignation, où les joueurs jugent directement leurs pairs sur l'ensemble de la planète. En effet, le scrutin masculin a réuni les votes de 19 806 footballeurs professionnels évoluant dans 73 pays différents. Une participation massive. Pour départager les nombreux prétendants et intégrer l'équipe type, la FIFPRO a appliqué une grille d'évaluation rigoureuse dès l'ouverture des votes.

According to recent reports, ainsi, la période de référence retenue pour analyser le rendement sur le terrain s'est étendue du 4 août 2025 au 19 juillet 2026 inclus. Au-delà des seules prestations sportives, une condition éliminatoire imposait aux nommés d'avoir disputé au minimum 30 matches officiels au cours de cet exercice.

Latest Update: OL : Carlos Vicens officiellement nommé pour succéder à Paulo Fonseca !

📅 09 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (535 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • According to recent reports, L'Olympique Lyonnais a officialisé ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 à 18h la nomination de Carlos Vicens au poste d'entraîneur principal.
  • Pour relancer l'équipe, la direction de l'OL a choisi de miser sur un profil au bagage formateur reconnu.
  • Industry observers note that fort de cette riche expérience, le nouvel entraîneur lyonnais s'était ensuite lancé comme numéro un au SC Braga lors de la saison 2025-2026.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, L'Olympique Lyonnais a officialisé ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 à 18h la nomination de Carlos Vicens au poste d'entraîneur principal. Libre depuis son licenciement du SC Braga, le technicien espagnol de 43 ans s'est engagé pour un an et demi, soit jusqu'au 30 juin 2028, avec pour objectif principal de décrocher une qualification européenne en mai prochain.

Pour relancer l'équipe, la direction de l'OL a choisi de miser sur un profil au bagage formateur reconnu. En effet, avant son expérience au Portugal, Carlos Vicens a passé huit saisons au sein de Manchester City. Vainqueur de la FA Youth Cup en 2020 avec les U18 du club anglais, l'Espagnol est ensuite devenu l'adjoint de Pep Guardiola entre 2021 et 2025. Un passage formateur au plus haut niveau.

Industry observers note that fort de cette riche expérience, le nouvel entraîneur lyonnais s'était ensuite lancé comme numéro un au SC Braga lors de la saison 2025-2026. Une aventure réussie avec une quatrième place en championnat portugais et une demi-finale de Ligue Europa, avant un licenciement survenu le 20 octobre 2026 après trois défaites consécutives.

In a recent development, dans son communiqué, le club rhodanien explique son choix : « La direction a ainsi retenu le profil de Carlos Vicens, dont l'approche du jeu, l'exigence et l'importance accordée au développement des joueurs correspondent pleinement aux orientations définies par le club ». Cette arrivée met un terme au feuilleton de la succession sur le banc rhodanien. L'OL devait en effet trouver un remplaçant à Paulo Fonseca, récemment parti pour le Sporting CP après 83 matches dirigés à Lyon, contre une indemnité estimée à 5 millions d'euros. Durant cette période délicate, Jorge Maciel avait assuré l'intérim. Toutefois, les difficultés sportives ont rapidement ressurgi en championnat.

Après un match nul contre la Real Sociedad (1-1) en Ligue Europa, les Lyonnais se sont inclinés à Brest (0-2) dimanche 8 novembre 2026 lors de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Une rencontre disputée en Bretagne pendant laquelle Carlos Vicens a visité les installations du club. L'Espagnol a ainsi découvert son futur cadre de travail avant de parapher son contrat de dix-huit mois.

Pour mener à bien sa mission, Carlos Vicens est accompagné par quatre adjoints, dont son assistant Mario Enguidanos (34 ans) et Lander Iza Garcia (30 ans), chargé de la performance. Dans un souci de continuité, le club a également maintenu des cadres techniques déjà en place : « Jorge Maciel conservera ses fonctions d'entraîneur adjoint, dans une volonté de continuité et avec la pleine confiance de la direction du club. Adrien Tarascon poursuivra également sa mission de responsable du développement individuel des joueurs, tandis que Sébastien Hamel, jusqu'ici entraîneur des gardiens de la Pro 2 depuis janvier 2025, rejoindra définitivement le staff. ».

Le technicien espagnol n'aura que peu de temps pour prendre ses marques. Carlos Vicens dirigera sa première séance d'entraînement mardi 10 novembre au matin avant d'être présenté aux médias à 15 heures. Au-delà des présentations, le travail tactique débutera sans attendre. Le premier match officiel de Carlos Vicens avec l'OL aura lieu le samedi 21 novembre 2026 face au LOSC au stade Pierre-Mauroy lors de la 11e journée de Ligue 1.
